# DevTools Hub

> Free collection of 371 browser-based developer tools across 11 categories. No signup, no tracking, all processing happens in your browser.

> Each tool has a markdown version at /tools/<slug>/.md for AI agents.

> For complete descriptions and details see [/llms-full.txt](https://tools.scoreroute.com/llms-full.txt).

## Site

- [Homepage](https://tools.scoreroute.com/): Browse all 371 free developer tools
- [Tools index](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/): All tools grouped by category
- [Feedback & Bug Reports](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/feedback/): Submit feedback, report bugs, request features

## Categories

- [Code Formatters (9 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/formatters/.md): Format, validate and beautify JSON, HTML, SQL, CSS, YAML and XML with exact error positions. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/formatters/)
- [Calculators (38 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/calculators/.md): Free online calculators for arithmetic, percentages, BMI, age, dates, tips and tiling. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/calculators/)
- [Generators (53 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/generators/.md): Generate passwords, QR codes, UUIDs, hashes, random numbers and citations in one click. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/generators/)
- [Converters (45 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/converters/.md): Convert units, currencies, time zones, file formats and text encodings in a single click. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/converters/)
- [Media Tools (69 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/media/.md): Compress, convert, crop, resize, transcribe and edit images, video and audio files in seconds. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/media/)
- [Network Tools (25 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/network/.md): Diagnose DNS, WHOIS, SSL, IP, email, proxies and internet speed from your browser. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/network/)
- [Code Testing (17 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/code-testing/.md): Test regex patterns, JWT tokens, grammar, text diffs, math and typing speed. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/code-testing/)
- [PDF Tools (25 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/pdf-tools/.md): Merge, split, compress, sign, redact and convert PDF files without ever uploading them. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/pdf-tools/)
- [Daily Life (36 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/life/.md): Everyday utilities for weather, world clock, stopwatch, timer, holidays and astronomy. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/life/)
- [Money & Markets (22 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/finance/.md): Live stock, crypto, gold and currency prices plus loan and mortgage calculators. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/finance/)
- [AI Language (32 tools)](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/ai-language/.md): Translate, paraphrase, detect AI-written text, cite sources and build resumes with AI. [HTML](https://tools.scoreroute.com/tools/ai-language/)
